'''2009 US West Nationals Day 1 Kyle Krueger DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kyle Krueger]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Boring
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
